block_selection_gate.capacity_required: selected pair count must not exceed the 139 V3-disjoint pairs
block_selection_gate.rule: Select the smallest candidate block count whose design-scenario Monte Carlo power and 95% Wilson lower endpoint are both at least 0.90.

primary_estimand.effect_unit: model seed by target semantic pattern
primary_estimand.formula: 100/(8*selected_target_count) times the sum over seeds and selected targets of row-weighted exposed-arm accuracy minus unexposed-arm accuracy
primary_estimand.pair_weighting: equal over every selected pair and its two members

power_simulation.design_effect_derivation: min(0.5 * V3 point estimate, V3 registered 95% lower endpoint)
power_simulation.standard_error: V3 seed-pair random-effects variance at S=8 and candidate Q, multiplied by the frozen V3 percentile-width calibration factor
power_simulation.success: simulated point estimate >= 1.0 pp and simulated two-sided 95% lower endpoint > 0

target_selection.candidate_order: Reconstruct all V3-eligible same-label adjacent pairs, sort globally by pair SHA-256, remove the exact 20 V3 pair hashes, then take the prefix required by the frozen block gate.

training_and_evaluation.common_base: One deterministic 22,720-row base shared across every block and arm; exclude every V3 target and every selected V4 target semantic ID.
training_and_evaluation.evaluation_allocation: For each selected target use the first 34 complete source groups: all rows from groups 0 through 32 and two rows from group 33.
training_and_evaluation.exposure_allocation: Use the next 11 complete source groups: all rows from groups 34 through 43 and four rows from group 44.
training_and_evaluation.per_block_semantics: Each block is a complete V3-sized 20-pair experiment; blocks are combined only in the frozen primary estimand.
